text:
Before: sushi (6 pieces, ~250 kcal, ~180 g), sandwich on a bagel/roll with chicken salad (~450 kcal, ~220 g, with half wrapped), spring rolls (2 rolls, ~200 kcal, ~150 g), fruit bowl (~80 kcal, ~150 g), chicken cabbage salad (~200 kcal, ~250 g), soy sauce (~10 kcal).

After: the sushi is mostly eaten, with about 1.5 pieces left (the pieces left appear to be seaweed-wrapped rolls). The sandwich is mostly uneaten: the wrapped half is intact and the other half is partly eaten, maybe a bit remains. The spring roll plate is empty. The fruit bowl is partly eaten, perhaps 40% left. The chicken salad is mostly eaten, with some chicken left on the plate with the sushi. Only greens remain on the other plate. The soy sauce is still there.

Eaten estimate:
- Sushi: about 75% eaten, ~190 kcal, 135 g.
- Sandwich: about 20% eaten of the unwrapped half, so perhaps 15% overall, ~70 kcal, 35 g. The unwrapped half appears to have been eaten partly, since it now shows a cut face with some filling missing. I'll say ~25% eaten, ~110 kcal, 55 g.
- Spring rolls: all eaten, ~200 kcal, 150 g.
- Fruit: ~60% eaten, ~50 kcal, 90 g.
- Salad: ~75% eaten, ~150 kcal, 180 g.

Total is about 700 kcal and 610 g.
